nodes.description: Private mapping tracking how many sales an address has performed; read by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping whitelisting addresses allowed to bypass sale conditions; set in _mints.
Private minimum sale value threshold set in init and checked in condition.
Private maximum sale value threshold set in init and checked in condition.
Private maximum number of sales per address set in init and checked in condition.
Address allowed to trade freely; written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Public token balance mapping mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public allowance mapping mutated by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Privileged owner address set in the constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public total supply set once in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used as scaling factor for _mints and init.
Constant Uniswap router address hardcoded as a whitelist bypass in ensure.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal view guard that whitelists owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition.
Public payable transfer entry point that mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit check reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall with attacker-supplied address and bytes.
Owner/whitelisted-address function that sets balanceOf and canSale without minting supply.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch airdrop with unchecked total computation and balance decrement.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist field.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and as transfer/approval owner throughout the contract.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata, allowing storage takeover if owner is compromised.
Unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom (Solidity 0.5.x, no SafeMath).
Unchecked subtraction of the batch total from the sender balance.
Unchecked balance addition in transferFrom that can silently overflow.
Unchecked per-recipient balance addition inside the batchSend loop.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Target address parameter of delegate.
Calldata bytes parameter of delegate.
Beneficiary address parameter of _mints.
Balance amount parameter of _mints.
Sale limit parameter of init.
Minimum sale parameter of init.
Maximum sale parameter of init.
Recipient array parameter of batchSend.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
Unchecked product _value * _tos.length computed in batchSend.
New trade address parameter of setTradeAddress.

edges.reason: transfer uses the untrusted caller address as the source of funds.
transfer forwards msg.sender, _to and _value into transferFrom.
transferFrom compares msg.sender against _from to authorize spending.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating state.
ensure falls back to condition when no whitelist branch matches.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to whitelist an address.
ensure reads tradeAddress to whitelist an address.
ensure reads owner when comparing _from/_to.
ensure reads the constant UNI address for whitelisting.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the expected Uniswap pair address.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to bound per-address sales.
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum amount.
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum amount.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom updates balanceOf for source and destination.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve sets the allowance owner from msg.sender.
delegate authorizes the caller against owner.
delegate forwards attacker-controlled address and calldata into delegatecall.
_mints authorizes the caller against owner or a hardcoded address.
_mints arbitrarily overwrites balanceOf[spender] without minting supply.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, bypassing sale limits.
init authorizes the caller against owner.
init sets the _minSale threshold.
init sets the _maxSale threshold.
init sets the _saleNum limit.
batchSend authorizes the caller against owner.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend mutates sender and recipient balances in a loop.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend performs unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value per recipient.
setTradeAddress authorizes the caller against owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
constructor sets the privileged owner address.
constructor assigns the entire supply to the deployer balance.
constructor grants an unlimited UNI allowance.
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals unchecked.
_from parameter feeds transferFrom balance and allowance logic.
_to parameter is the transferFrom recipient.
_value parameter drives all unchecked transferFrom arithmetic.
delegate target address is caller-supplied and passed to delegatecall.
delegate calldata bytes are caller-supplied and executed via delegatecall.
_mints spender parameter receives an arbitrary balance and whitelist flag.
_mints addedValue is scaled and written to balanceOf.
init saleNum parameter sets the _saleNum limit.
init token parameter sets _minSale.
init maxToken parameter sets _maxSale.
_tos parameter supplies array length used in the unchecked total computation.
_value parameter is multiplied by array length without overflow checks.
setTradeAddress addr parameter becomes the whitelisted trade address.

Parameter is only assigned to the _maxSale state variable.
